title: Karta Workload Structure

options.content:
# Workload -> Components -> Pods
Choose a namespace and workload. The graph uses verified Pod attribution. Gray workload nodes do not indicate GPU inactivity; the separate activity observer is not installed.

panels.title: Karta attribution structure
panels.description: Live projection of Karta attribution metrics, not the full desired library tree or Kubernetes ownerReferences. Solid edges show component/instance attribution; dashed edges show the separate logical replica-group axis. Pod nodes are unique by namespace and Pod UID. workload nodes persist with zero mapped Pods. Missing children are not invented. Counts show mapped Pods, not desired replicas. workload color is workload-level GPU activity evidence only.
